collection.description: A cold fog has rolled in overnight and the encampment's fire has gone out.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A cold fog rolls in from the sea overnight and the encampment's fire has gone out. (subject) and (friend) are the first ones up.

choices.label: Huddle Up and Wait It Out

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: It takes them all morning with damp wood, and a lot of words they wouldn't say in front of the children. When the fire finally catches, half the camp is already sitting around it, waiting, as though they had known it would.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: They wrap up in every blanket they can find and wait for the sun. It comes out at midday. (friend) declares that the sun did all the work and the fire can stay out until tomorrow.
